items.coder_A: ["other", false, ""] (EGFR amplification / +7/-10 / TERT promoter mutation, role eligibility)
items.proposed: not a selection biomarker (drop the eligibility row; at most a diagnostic criterion)
items.reason: These features are only an alternative route to the GBM diagnosis ("molecular diagnosis of glioblastoma per ... c-IMPACT-NOW criteria"; "this requires presence of amplification of EGFR, whole chromosome 7 gain AND whole chromosome 10 loss, or TERT promoter mutation"), like IDH-wildtype used only to define GBM; they do not select a subgroup and match no candidate (tocilizumab, atezolizumab).

items.proposed: MGMT not an eligibility biomarker (exploratory_correlative); any_molecular_selection=false
items.reason: The criterion only requires that a result exist: "MGMT methylation status must be available from any prior GBM tumor specimen"; no methylation status is required for entry, so it is not an entry requirement on the biomarker. Not candidate-matched in any case (MGMT never matched unless MGMT-targeting).

note: Primary outcome is negative under either coder's version (both rows candidate_matched=false). The only effect of the MGMT decision is on any_molecular_selection: if XL reads an 'MGMT status must be available' criterion as an eligibility biomarker, any_molecular_selection becomes true. IDH (exclusion of IDH-mutant tumours) defines GBM only and does not count.
